title: kbingest map's environment scrub leaves toolchain variables that name relative clone programs, and its cargo credential-provider settings pass
goal: kbingest.scrub_env gives a mapper child an allow-list environment (the variables a build needs, no toolchain hook variable such as CARGO_BUILD_*, CARGO_TARGET_*_LINKER, RUSTFLAGS, GOFLAGS, RUBYOPT, PERL5OPT, JAVA_TOOL_OPTIONS, BASH_ENV, GIT_EXEC_PATH, GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL, GIT_SSH_COMMAND, npm_config_userconfig or LD_LIBRARY_PATH) instead of dropping names from a deny-list, and config_program declines registry.credential-provider, registries.*.credential-provider and doc.browser, with a test named scrub_env_allowlist that plants each variable and each setting. Third round of the same class (BG-iusez2hr, BG-3mc5q36g): the deny-list leaves the next gap each time.

run: import sys;sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import kbingest as k;e=k.scrub_env({'CARGO_BUILD_RUSTC_WRAPPER':'tools/w','PATH':'/usr/bin'},windows=False,root='/x/root',repo='/x/repo');sys.exit(1 if 'CARGO_BUILD_RUSTC_WRAPPER' in e else 0)

gates.question: Which variables does the kbingest map allow-list keep, and are toolchain homes (CARGO_HOME, RUSTUP_HOME, DOTNET_ROOT, GOROOT, GOPATH, GOMODCACHE, GOCACHE) kept?
